Haemme nyt

Helikopteriasentajaa

Kouvolan Uttiin vakituiseen työsuhteeseen NH90-helikopterin huolto-, korjaus- ja modifikaatiotehtäviin.

Tehtävässä vastaat helikoptereiden määräaikaishuolloista, vikadiagnostiikasta, korjauksista sekä lentokelpoisuuden varmistamisesta yhteistyössä muun tiimin kanssa. Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat mekaaniset ja mahdollisesti sähköiset huollot, sekä erilaiset korjaus- ja kunnossapitotyöt helikoptereille. In this role, you will maintain the organization’s process mapping standards, policies, and guidelines and ensure that they remain clear and practical across the organization. You will build, maintain and continuously develop Patria’s enterprise process map in close cooperation with internal stakeholders. You will also design and implement group-wide process management practices.

A key part of your work will be to analyze existing processes, identify development opportunities, and support the implementation of agreed improvements together with the relevant functions. You will plan, deliver and document process management training and guidance. You will also act as a system administrator and key user for process mapping and process management tools.

- A relevant technical degree, such as a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering; the specific field of study is not essential.

- Some experience in process development, continuous improvement, or other development-oriented tasks. We also welcome applications from recent graduates with suitable educational backgrounds.

- Strong collaboration and teamwork skills, as the role involves working closely with colleagues and stakeholders across the organization.

- Confident communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to discuss different perspectives and build shared solutions.

We offer you

You have a chance for a long and versatile career with Patria’s unique products and services. In this position, you will have a great opportunity to impact Patria’s international growth and be part of steering our way into the future.

We offer you personnel benefits, such as an annual performance bonus and vast employment benefits. We have a comprehensive occupational health, which includes e.g. specialists. We also offer free time accident insurance.

You can submit your application through our recruitment system. Please apply by 13.10.2026. Please note that we do not process applications sent by email.

For more information about the position, please contact

📧 ext-jenni.autio@patriagroup.com

1. Securing society: We are proud to advance national and international security. It requires a responsible attitude and excellence that guarantees reliability in all conditions
